direction: Cinematic ultramarine gas giant; detailed turbulent clouds and two cyclonic storms; strong upper-left sunlight, dark navy hemisphere, icy atmospheric rim and fine champagne/silver icy rings. Landscape 3:2 composition on pure black, with all ring ends visible. No lettering or additional planets.
export: The WebGL material exported a static premultiplied composite at time zero. For black-backed input, alpha is the maximum RGB channel, with an opaque interior globe; preserve the original RGB in premultiplied output to avoid dark edge contamination. The PNG is the static fallback and the live material input.
motion: Bounded longitude advection of the visible cloud surface. The single-view asset does not reconstruct a full 360-degree rotation. The ring/silhouette and baked light remain fixed.
moon: The desktop moon reuses /paw-media/starfield/moon-512.jpg; its attribution is in public/paw-media/starfield/ATTRIBUTION.md.
supersedes: The procedural satin globe and two rejected macOS image-generation studies are not shipped.
